issues.problem: Definition includes activity/occurrence but does not distinguish a represented event argument from the verb implementing the current assistant task.
issues.candidate_rule: Count an event/activity when the utterance refers to it as an object of scheduling, reminder, query, report or message content. A bare verb that only specifies the current assistant operation does not alone create an event role. Past events may count when explicitly represented as query/report subjects.

issues.problem: The words news or information admit almost every factual query and leave scope unclear.
issues.candidate_rule: Require an expressed news/report/update context before assigning a news subject; a bare general factual, mailbox or weather query does not automatically create news_topic. Decide explicitly whether non-news informational subject matter is intended as a separate operator.

issues.problem: Name/title and identifying reference wording have inconsistent specificity requirements.
issues.candidate_rule: Distinguish reference to a specific work from a generic medium/category or unconstrained request for any matching item; explicitly decide whether possessive/deictic references without a title suffice, and apply the same rule across work types.

issues.problem: Some type cards accept property names while explicit_filler wording rejects required but unstated values; interrogative role expressions are not consistently specified.
issues.candidate_rule: Record per type whether an explicitly named property or interrogative role expression itself meets the definition; never infer presence from a task normally requiring that property.

issues.problem: Personal attributes versus relational designations, and meaning requests versus arbitrary property requests, remain broad.
issues.candidate_rule: Separate requested concept meaning from arbitrary facts about an entity; assess social relations and personal attributes independently using expressed evidence, without generic factual-question closure.

policy: Previously registered five rule families plus human-owner/content-channel boundaries have selected versions. Rating attachment remains input ambiguity; full current-rule annotation/admission is incomplete. No automatic historical label admission.

remaining_after_current_rule_rereview.question: Does a possessive identifying a work establish a task-relevant human participant, independently of first-person grammar?
Does a named publication channel also establish media_type when its access-application role is explicit?
Rating of podcast versus its songs is not settled by the utterance; do not invent a precedence rule or use native labels.

subsequent_batch_issues.standalone_report_scope: unresolved; no global scope revision or native-intent-based admission
